written_before: any T2 training run and before unblinding any post-training eval. This protocol freezes the independent π₀ baseline census that defines the ONLY main-eval panels for T2. It is a prerequisite of the later training-protocol freeze (protocol.t2_training.v1.json) and does NOT amend the frozen audit freeze_ordering in protocol.t2_expert_audit.v1.json. Baseline commit at freeze: 1eb5f17.

protocol.t1.v1.json.role: base policy, Beta-Binomial grouping model, disjointness reservation

protocol.t2_expert_audit.v1.json.role: frozen cell geometry rule (arm × container × y-band); probe facts referenced for identifiability floors

capability_cells.place_container_plate.v.role: frozen cell_rule only; eval census builds a fresh seed→cell map on the 200-seed pool and does NOT copy rankings or fallback orders from the 50-seed file

t2_selection.place_container_plate.v1.js.role: Cover-12 occupied source cells for within/cross-cell panel definition

motivation.problem: The union of all six T2 training-point trajectory sources covers 28/50 original hard seeds. The remaining 22 non-overlapping hard seeds are all cup cells; no right-bowl seed remains on the original 50-hard panel. Using those 50 seeds as the main Δ_H panel would confound capability transport on the dominant right|002_bowl region with memorization on training-adjacent seeds.
motivation.solution: Run an independent π₀ census on 200 reserved env seeds (100500–100699), freeze E/M/H and cell-stratified hard panels from that census alone, and restrict primary Δ_H and Γ to those panels. The original 50 hard seeds become a memorization diagnostic only.

frozen_probe_facts.note: Recorded here for identifiability panel definition; do not reopen probe or selection.

seed_pool.manifest_status_warning: That multitask manifest remains candidate_unvalidated; seed IDs do NOT guarantee difficulty. Difficulty is assigned ONLY from this census result via Beta-Binomial posterior mean.

disjoint_from.t2_trajectory_source_union: 28 env seeds drawn from the frozen t2_selection.place_container_plate.v1.json arms (Cover/Random/Self-Diverse and dose-20 extensions); exact list is the set union of all trajectory env_seed fields in that file
disjoint_from.note: This census CONSUMES the T1-reserved confirmation band for place T2. T3 confirmatory eval on place must not reuse 100500–100699.

measurement.policy_seed_rule: policy_seed = 7000 + repeat (repeat in 0..7); disjoint from T1b offset 5000 and T1c offset 6000
measurement.missingness_rule: UnStableError episodes are operational missingness (evaluated=false); excluded from the p0 denominator; seeds are never swapped

difficulty_grouping.model: Beta-Binomial posterior p0 | s ~ Beta(1 + s, 1 + R_eval - s), R_eval = evaluated repeats per seed

groups.unsupported_tail: s = 0 of R_eval evaluated repeats (subset of hard, flagged separately)

difficulty_grouping.freeze_rule: t2_eval_panels.place_container_plate.v1.json (+ sha256) written once from the completed census ONLY; never regrouped from any post-treatment checkpoint

capability_cells.implementation: make_capability_cells.extract_geometry + cell_key on each census seed via real env setup_demo
capability_cells.scope: seed → cell mapping for eval stratification only; no rankings, no fallback orders, no probe coupling

eval_panel_roles.primary_delta_h_and_gamma: independent hard panel from this census ONLY
eval_panel_roles.regression_panels: independent easy and medium panels from this census for Δ_E and Δ_M non-inferiority
eval_panel_roles.within_cell_hard: hard-panel seeds whose cell is one of the five Cover-12 occupied source cells listed in frozen_probe_facts
eval_panel_roles.cross_cell_hard: hard-panel seeds whose cell is NOT in that five-cell union
eval_panel_roles.dominant_transport_target: hard-panel seeds in right|002_bowl|y1 OR right|002_bowl|y2
eval_panel_roles.memorization_diagnostic: the 50 original T1b hard seeds (difficulty_groups.place_container_plate.v1.json groups.hard); EXCLUDED from primary Δ_H, Γ₁₂, and Γ₂₀; reported separately as train-seed overlap diagnostic

identifiability_floors.note: Frozen BEFORE seeing census results. Failure emits t2_eval_unidentifiable.place_container_plate.v1.json and blocks T2 training launch. No seed swapping, no pool widening, no borrowing T1b leftovers.

infeasibility_outcome.action: Do NOT freeze protocol.t2_training.v1.json or launch the 72 training jobs. Report which floor(s) failed.

collector_rules.note: machine-readable mirror; run_t2_eval_census.sh and eval_per_seed.py must match.
collector_rules.gpu_packing: 8 GPUs × 3 simulator workers = 24 shards; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES set per shard
